method: LATEST task b12-ics, 23 Nov 2026. 36 lines: 32 priced, 2 NO-LISTING (Sony image sensors), 1 SUMMARY-ONLY (SKYA21003), 1 not reached with a page read (SKYA21041) - both Skyworks lines are in notResearched with the exact code / URL (one Digi-Key read each). Every figure in observations was read in the VISIBLE price table of the distributor product page today (evidence page-read); no search-summary figure, no hidden page data, nothing scaled. Per part from the Digi-Key page (digikey.com, USD, no VAT): the break nearest 1,000 (its packing stated) and the smallest and largest break of the full packaging (reel / tube). Digi-Key prints cut tape and Digi-Reel in one table - recorded as cut tape. Rows printed as "Bulk" on non-stocked factory-order parts are recorded as bulk. PACING: sleep 20 before every Digi-Key / Master read, 65 s between TME reads, one page at a time. Budget used: 3 web searches (orderable codes / listings only - no price taken), 49 page requests: Digi-Key 34 (33 served = 32 product pages + 1 list page for A6985F; the 34th, keyword IMX728, returned HTTP 403 - Digi-Key NOT read again, no other Digi-Key host tried); Master Electronics 2 served ("no search results" for STPS5H100BY-TR; "no exact match" for LMV321IYLT, an onsemi part offered instead - Master does not carry STMicroelectronics, not used further); TME 8 served (the task limit: 3 search pages that give only product links, 5 product pages; no 429) - TME prints 2 decimals and, for these parts, either small breaks (below 100) or ONE custom-order factory-pack break from "external stock"; Mouser 1 (HTTP 503) and Arrow 1 (HTTP 503) - not used again; LCSC 1 (product page served, no visible price); sony-semicon.com 1 (grade statement); skyworksinc.com 1 (no content). Farnell / Newark, RS, Future, Avnet, Rutronik, Verical were not tried (refused on every agent's single try earlier today). So 30 of the 32 priced parts have Digi-Key only; 2 MCUs have a TME cross-check at 500. GRADE: 28 lines have Digi-Key page fields Grade "Automotive" + Qualification AEC-Q100 / AEC-Q101 (11 of them had aecq false in the task - now confirmed true); the 4 NCS101x combination sensors have NO Grade / Qualification field - aecq false. SLOPE WARNINGS: (1) Digi-Key prices the first reel break ABOVE the largest cut-tape break on TSB572IYST, LMV321IYLT, ALED7709ATR, L99DZ100GTR, L99LDLH32TR, L99MH98-TR - recorded as shown; on the last three the reel has ONE break, so the pair gives no usable slope (it would be negative). (2) SCT011HU75G3AG, SCT020H120G3AG, SCT020HU120G3AG, SPC58EC80E3QMC1Y have ONE break >= 100 only. (3) Most ST power parts show cut tape only to 500, so "nearest 1,000" is the 500 row.
